summary: 3 Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation techniques for Kubernetes Persistence.
description: Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation techniques for Kubernetes targeting the Persistence tactic. Each script invokes the official Stratus binary using an isolated Morgana correlation ID for Detection Fabric correlation. Prerequisite cloud infrastructure is managed by Stratus warmup. Cleanup is performed via the separate cleanup_command using the same correlation ID.
purpose: Validate Kubernetes Persistence detection rules, SIEM alerts, and SOC workflows in an authorized cloud sandbox.
capabilities: 3 Stratus Red Team techniques for Kubernetes Persistence.
Official Stratus binary execution — no custom attack code.
Morgana Test ID used as Stratus correlation ID for Detection Fabric correlation.
Separate detonate + cleanup lifecycle with state preservation.
use_cases: Validate Kubernetes Persistence detection in an authorized cloud sandbox.
Exercise SIEM, CSPM, cloud-native detection, and SOC workflows with real cloud API activity.
Confirm detection rules fire on real technique execution before incident response exercises.
prerequisites: kubectl configured with a valid kubeconfig and current context pointing to an authorized test cluster.
RBAC permissions appropriate for the techniques being tested.
Never run against production Kubernetes clusters.
safety_notes: Stratus Red Team is designed for authorized sandbox cloud environments only.
Never execute against production cloud accounts, subscriptions, or clusters.
Some techniques create real cloud resources that incur cost — always run cleanup after detonation.
Warmup may take 1–5 minutes for Terraform-based infrastructure setup.
Cleanup uses the same correlation ID; ensure MORGANA_TEST_ID matches the detonation Test.
author: Datadog / Stratus Red Team

scripts.name: STRATUS - KUBERNETES - Create Admin ClusterRole
scripts.description:
Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation technique for Kubernetes.

Create Admin ClusterRole

Creates a Service Account bound to a cluster administrator role. Warm-up: None Detonation: - Create a Cluster Role with administrative permissions - Create a Service Account (in the

Morgana executes the official Stratus technique using an isolated MORGANA_TEST_ID correlation ID. Prerequisite infrastructure is handled by Stratus warmup. Cleanup uses the same correlation ID.
scripts.command:
# Stratus Red Team — Create Admin ClusterRole
# Correlation ID = Morgana Test ID for Detection Fabric correlation
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-$(uuidgen 2>/dev/null || cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid 2>/dev/null || echo manual)}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if [ -n "#{stratus_kube_context}" ]; then KUBE_ARGS="--kubeconfig $HOME/.kube/config"; fi

# Select Stratus binary for this Agent OS
if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
  chmod +x "$STRATUS_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

echo "[INFO] Stratus Red Team: technique=k8s.persistence.create-admin-clusterrole"
echo "[INFO] Correlation ID: $STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID"

# Warmup + Detonate
"$STRATUS_BIN" detonate k8s.persistence.create-admin-clusterrole
EXIT_CODE=$?

echo "[INFO] Detonation complete: exit=$EXIT_CODE technique=k8s.persistence.create-admin-clusterrole"
# Emit structured result
echo "MORGANA_RESULT_METADATA={\"provider\":\"stratus-red-team\",\"technique_id\":\"k8s.persistence.create-admin-clusterrole\",\"correlation_id\":\"$STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID\",\"exit_code\":$EXIT_CODE}"
exit $EXIT_CODE
scripts.cleanup_command:
# Stratus Red Team cleanup — uses SAME correlation ID as detonation
# MORGANA_TEST_ID must match the value used during detonate
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-manual}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
fi

"$STRATUS_BIN" cleanup k8s.persistence.create-admin-clusterrole
CLEANUP_EXIT=$?
echo "[INFO] Cleanup complete: exit=$CLEANUP_EXIT technique=k8s.persistence.create-admin-clusterrole"
exit $CLEANUP_EXIT
